newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures mixed, marks touch new low.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures mixed, marks touch new low.

text.p: April 15 - IMM currency futures were mixed at midmorning, with June marks briefly sagging to another new contract low. Marks had cut losses but soon fell again to a new contract low at $0.5780, or about 1.7376 spot, after Buba economist Otmar Issing said Euro launch could cause shifts from mark to dollar investments. Next support near $0.5774 or about 1.7394 spot. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
